brief:
Israeli airstrikes on al-Tuffah district in Gaza City wounded nine people, including a child, Shehab Wire reported. The strikes struck residential areas of the densely populated neighborhood, with rescue teams responding to reports of casualties among civilians present at the time of impact.

The attack occurred as Israeli military operations continued across Gaza. Al-Tuffah, located in the northern part of Gaza City, has faced repeated bombardment throughout the conflict. Medics treated the wounded at local hospitals as emergency services assessed the full extent of damage to buildings in the neighborhood.
